questionText: A is 1.5 times efficient as B and therefore takes 8 days less than B to complete a work. If A and B work on alternate days and A works on the first day, then in how many days will the work be completed?

A and B are both capable of doing a task in 45 and 40 days, respectively?
Together, they started the task, but after a few days, A left, and B finished the
remaining work in 23 days. The number of days A and B worked together is?

Anshu can do a piece of work in 24 days, and Kajal can do it in 28 days. They
work together for 6 days after which Anshu leaves the work, and the remaining
work is completed by Kajal alone. In how many days will the entire work be
completed?
